pool.text: Thomas Gilbert arrived as the first European to describe Tarawa on the Charlotte vessel.
The island of Tarawa was successfully mapped by the United States Exploring Expedition.
Captain Edward Davis proclaimed Tarawa as a British Protectorate after HMS Royalist arrived.
Charles Richard Swayne decided to install the central headquarters of the protectorate in Tarawa.
The Tarawa Post Office officially opened at the beginning of January.
Sir Arthur Grimble became the Resident Commissioner of the colony in Tarawa.
The bloody Battle of Tarawa began after the island was occupied by the Japanese.
Frank Filan won a Pulitzer Prize for his photograph depicting a destroyed bunker.
A Belgian comic titled Tarawa Atoll Sanglant was written by two creators.
A British drama film named Pacific Destiny was made based on a book.
The embassy of China located in South Tarawa was closed.
Tarawa Atoll is featured as the penultimate battle of a video game.
Homer Hickam described the Battle of Tarawa in his historical novel.
Leon Cooper returned to the island to investigate reports of garbage on the beach.
The Kiribati Government began a road restoration project funded by the World Bank.
The embassy of China in South Tarawa was officially re-opened.
The embassy of Japan was opened as a resident diplomatic mission in South Tarawa.
